analysis_plan.secondary: Each candidate versus genetic control on the panel; direct pairwise games are descriptive
analysis_plan.selection: All saved candidates locked before new games; no reselection or tuning
analysis_plan.limits: One kingdom and five previously inspected search runs; post-hoc diagnostic, not a new equal-compute algorithm comparison or proof of descent from a proposal
